text:
We are forwarding one copy of your draft environmental statement to the Governor's Office of Environmental Quality Control. It is the agency in our State which reviews and processes all required Federal and State environmental statements. It also makes the statements available to other governmental agencies and the general public. Should further comments be forthcoming, we have asked that office to forward them to you. Our copy of the statement shall also be made available for public review. Thank you for the opportunity of reviewing your statement.
Sincerely,
Shellev M. Mark
